summary: Round 1 (new module). Both marks are earned. Prop. 1 (`FCone.prop1_F_homogene`) carries exactly B locally projective + [T2Space B] (the « variété » reading, plan F6, DEC-124/127), nothing else: no paracompactness, no connectedness, no second countability. Homogeneous = F(φ) then a homothety; sweepable = a compact K₁ with π(K₁) ⊇ K (the printed « compact section » in the form the argument uses, no global section needed, which is right because π is open and F(B) locally compact); divisible = the printed group F(G) × λ^ℤ (range of `divHom`), properly discontinuous through FCone.properSMul (DEC-122/124), free, cocompact. « Automorphisme » is GXAut of the affine structure, and `IsGXMorphism.affine_of_cone` is the printed « donc aussi de sa structure localement affine ». The circle corollary (`produit_cercle`) carries [T2Space B] [ParacompactSpace B]: Hausdorff + second countable + locally Euclidean ⇒ paracompact, so paracompactness is WEAKER than the « variété » reading and the hypotheses are honest; « no compactness needed » is right (the printed corollary has none; only the proof's « En particulier » sentence does, and the formal proof needs only a global section of F(B) → B). kb/0002 clean (the uniqueness clause compares cs' with cs, verified on the elaborated term). The global instance `FCone.instChartedSpaceAff` coexists with the cone charted space without ambiguity or diamond (Mathlib's `ChartedSpace` takes the model as an explicit, non-outParam argument; both `#synth` succeed, `chartAt _ x` is stuck rather than ambiguous). No blocker, no major; four nits. Ready to graduate.

open_question: Does « B × S¹ locally affine » hold for a Hausdorff, NON-paracompact locally projective B? Not settled; assessment: (i) the formal route genuinely needs paracompactness — principal ℝ₊*-bundles (≅ orientable line bundles) over non-paracompact Hausdorff manifolds can be non-trivial (H¹(B; C(−,ℝ)) need not vanish; e.g. Morrow, « The tangent bundle of the long line », Proc. AMS 1969, gives smoothings of the long line with non-trivial tangent bundle — reference not archived, quoted from memory); (ii) but such an example carries no projective structure: every continuous map from a long ray into ℝ, hence into the compact metric S^n ⊂ ℝ^{n+1}, is eventually constant, so a developing map (a local homeomorphism on the universal cover, which still contains a lifted long ray) cannot exist — any Hausdorff manifold containing an embedded long ray admits no locally projective (nor locally affine) structure; (iii) so a counterexample would have to be non-paracompact without long rays (Prüfer/Moore-type, separable non-metrizable surfaces), with F(B) → B non-trivial AND B × S¹ admitting no affine structure by any other construction (F(B)/λ^ℤ is still locally affine and is a principal S¹-bundle over B, just possibly not B × S¹). Nothing in the paper needs this: Benzécri's « variété » is second countable, hence paracompact. Recommend recording it as a remark (not an OQ, not a finding) and keeping the mark
fidelity_summary: Prop. 1 is the printed statement with the single « variété » reading B Hausdorff, and its proof is the printed one (F(φ) and homotheties; a compact lift of a generating domain; F(G) × λ^ℤ). The circle corollary is the printed statement under « variété » = Hausdorff + paracompact (implied by second countability, strictly weaker), with no compactness, as printed; its full proof sentence (F(B)/λ^ℤ locally affine and ≃ₜ B × S¹ over B) is also formalized. The affine instance on FCone is safe as a global instance. Graduation: ready; the nits are docstring/REPORT edits.
